title: Stepper motors (step / dir with acceleration)
summary: Two stepper axes for driver boards like A4988, DRV8825 or TMC2208: smooth speed-up and slow-down computed in hardware every microsecond, exact stop at the target.
wiring: the driver's logic supply at 3.3 V (VDD of the A4988 / DRV8825 board)
enabled all the time (or a spare pin)
parts: 100 uF capacitor at the driver's motor supply
tested: the self-test passed 8 of 8 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
